info.description: The routes of the MPC shop system. Every refusal has one shape: {"code", "message", "fields", "params"}; the app translates the code.

FlagKindEnum.description:
* `cash_difference` - Cash difference
* `count_difference` - Count difference
* `delivery_difference` - Delivery difference
* `transfer_difference` - Transfer difference
* `negative_stock` - Negative stock
* `duplicate_code` - Duplicate transaction code
* `late_record` - Late record
* `unverified_time` - Unverified time
* `missing_clock_out` - Missing clock-out
* `suspended_staff_activity` - Suspended staff activity
* `device_gap` - Device gap
* `balance_mismatch` - Balance mismatch
* `open_bag_difference` - Open bag difference
* `production_loss` - Production loss
* `total_mismatch` - Total mismatch
* `permission_break` - Permission break
* `drawer_conflict` - Drawer conflict
* `invalid_document` - Invalid document

id.description: The period's id, made on the laptop (UUIDv7).

started_at.description: When the laptop's line went, by its clock.

ended_at.description: When it came back, by its clock.

cursor.description: The last change number this page read, sent or passed over, or the cursor asked when none came: the next pull asks from it.

has_more.description: More changes wait after this page: ask again at once, from its cursor. A page can hold fewer than 1,000 changes and still have more after it.

sent_at.description: The laptop's clock as it sends this push.

app_version.description: The app's version on the laptop.

unsent_count.description: How many records the laptop holds unsent, besides these.

first.description:
A duplicate's first answer.

* `accepted` - Accepted
* `invalid` - Invalid

posted_seq.description: The last change number its save took.

code.description: An invalid one's reason, as the error shape names it.

id.description: The document's id, made on the laptop (UUIDv7).

client_time.description: The laptop's clock when it was made: kept, never trusted.

created_by.description: The staff member who made it at the counter.

payload.description: The document itself, in its type's shape.
